Variants.Content: Entry Westeros justice is a composite of royal decrees, local customs, the traditions of the Church of the Seven, seigneurial jurisdiction, and ancient noble prerogatives. The king can judge major cases in the royal capital, the lord can judge theft, land and debt in his own territory, and the bachelor and steward are responsible for Law is not only a language that limits violence, but also a tool for those with power to demonstrate their power. Commoners are more concerned about whether the judgment is fair and whether compensation is paid, while nobles are more concerned about whether the trial recognizes identity and family honor.
